summary: Jasper Therapeutics filed an 8-K confirming the issuance of contractual contingent value rights (CVRs) to its shareholders in connection with its acquisition of Kira Pharmaceuticals, announced July 16, 2026. Each share of Jasper common stock held at the record date (July 16, 2026) receives one CVR entitling the holder to a pro rata portion of a $30.0 million milestone payment if the FDA issues a Priority Review Voucher for briquilimab by December 31, 2028. CVRs are non-transferable, uncertificated, not SEC-registered or exchange-listed. If a change of control occurs, the payment accelerates; otherwise, payment follows a monetization event. The acquisition consideration includes the CVRs, but the filing discloses no base price per share or premium. The CVRs are contingent on regulatory approval, creating a binary, time-limited milestone risk. Watch for FDA action on briquilimab and any change-of-control developments that could trigger early payment.
